text:
emma_support: Heads-up — customer ACME (acme-prod) just opened an escalation: their Payments latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after last night's metrics deploy. Charts show flatlines or zeros on route-level panels when filtered to /v1/payments. Can someone triage?
liam_sre: Ack. I saw a spike in agg errors around the deploy window, might be related to percentile rollups.
devin_platform: I flipped metric-aggregator v2 to canary at 23:45 UTC. It changes how we store percentiles (on-query summaries vs precomputed rollups). Panels that expect precomputed series will appear empty.
emma_support: Ugh. Customer says this affects only tenant/route panels, org-level overview still ok. Repro steps?
liam_sre: Repro locally: set time window to 23:30-00:30, filter by org=acme-prod + route=/v1/payments -> p95/p99 series missing. If you remove the route filter the org-level panel shows p95 again.
jonah_eng: Can you paste the aggregator logs for that timeframe? also is there a feature flag?
liam_sre: Logs (excerpt):
```
[23:46:12] aggregator v2 initialized: percentile_mode=on_query
[23:46:13] warning: rollup_writer disabled for tenant=acme-prod
[23:46:13] error: failed to write percentile_rollup: unsupported_schema
[23:47:01] debug: fallback to summary_on_query
```
opsbot: Deploybot: metric-aggregator:v2 deployed canary -> telemetry-cluster (23:45 UTC) :white_check_mark:
monitoring_bot: Alert triggered: percentile_rollup_write_errors > 100 in 5m on telemetry-cluster (23:48 UTC)
maria_cs: Customer on the line asking for ETA, they say product analytics look broken for a couple teams.
devin_platform: Confirmed — v2 intentionally changed the storage schema to reduce storage cost, but we missed a compatibility shim for tenant-scoped rollups. My bad, that's on me.
jonah_eng: Short-term mitigation: re-enable legacy rollup path for affected tenants via FF. I can push a compat flag. Command (k8s):
```
kubectl -n telemetry set env deploy/aggregator PERCENTILE_COMPAT=legacy
kubectl rollout restart deploy/aggregator
```
liam_sre: If we do that we'll need to re-run the rollup writer for the window to backfill series so dashboards pick up data. Backfill command: `python tools/backfill_rollups.py --org acme-prod --start 2026-03-16T23:30Z --end 2026-03-17T01:00Z`
emma_support: Can we target only acme-prod so we don't revert the performance benefits for everyone?
devin_platform: Yes, the flag is per-tenant. I'll gate it to acme-prod and a few impacted tenants. Rolling that now.
opsbot: Opsbot: Set env PERCENTILE_COMPAT=legacy for aggregators (applied to 2/3 pods)
liam_sre: I've queued the backfill as a low-priority job. ETA ~45m, will update when finished.
maria_cs: I told the customer we have a targeted mitigant and a backfill scheduled, they'll be on standby. Asking if they want a rollback instead.
devin_platform: Rolling full rollback is heavier; prefer targeted compat + backfill. If backfill fails we'll rollback the canary.
jonah_eng: Postmortem items: add automated compatibility check for aggregator schema changes, add console fallback to on-query summaries (show dashed series) and an alert that points to recent aggregator deploys.
emma_support: Thanks team — keep me posted and I'll update ACME support channel.
liam_sre: Backfill completed at 00:25 UTC, I can see p95/p99 series repopulating for acme-prod. Closing in 20m if no regressions.
emma_support: Customer confirmed lines are back on their dashboard; closing escalation. :tada:
